sentence: The room's organizing restates in the model's terms — calls and joining (t01), spot-finding (t02), keeping every pixel repaired (t03), PlaceBot scripts (t04), redesign (t06), celebration at success (t07), neighbourly restraint (t09), rival taunts and score-settling (t10), locating the finished spot (t14) — but t05 (a logo bringing newcomers into the room) and t11 (working out whose neighbouring mark it is) carry organizing the model lacks, so the residue is listed.
